newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt air cargo up 1.7 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt air cargo up 1.7 pct in June.

text.p: Air cargo flown to and from Frankfurt airport(FRA) grew moderately by 1.7 percent in June year-on-year, airport authority figures showed.
Half-year figures showed 2.8 percent growth to date in 1997, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG traffic report said.
Export freight rose in particular to Asia and the entire American continent last month, it noted.

But the transfer of several Lufthansa Cargo freighter services from Frankfurt to Cologne at the start of the summer timetable had caused an effective three percent drop in growth rates, the report added.
